paper.title: Achieving adaptivity and optimality for multi-armed bandits using Exponential-Kullback Leibler Maillard Sampling

settings.name_in_paper: K-armed bandit with rewards from a known one-parameter exponential distribution (OPED) family (Assumptions 1, 3)
unmapped: log-partition function b twice differentiable with continuous b''>0 (Assumption 1)
OPED family with identity sufficient statistic
settings.definition_quote: There exists a known OPED family $\Fcal_m$ s.t. $\forall a \in [K]$, $\nu_a \in \Fcal_m$. ... $b(\theta)$ is twice differentiable with a continuous second derivative $b''(\theta) > 0$

settings.name_in_paper: OPED bandit with maximum variance assumption (Assumptions 1, 2, 3)
unmapped: every distribution in the OPED family has variance at most V_bar (Assumption 2)
log-partition function b twice differentiable with continuous b''>0 (Assumption 1)
settings.definition_quote: For any distribution $p_\theta$ in $\Fcal_m$, its variance is bounded above by $\bar{V} > 0$.

settings.name_in_paper: OPED bandit with Lipschitz variance function (Assumptions 1, 3, 4)
unmapped: variance function V(mu) is C_L-Lipschitz on (0, M] (Assumption 4)
log-partition function b twice differentiable with continuous b''>0 (Assumption 1)
settings.definition_quote: For any bandit instance from a known distribution family $\Fcal_m(M)$ with a Variance function $V(\cdot)$, there exists $C_L > 0$ such that $\forall \mu, \mu' \in (0, M]$, $\abs{V(\mu) - V(\mu')} \leq C_L\abs{ \mu - \mu' }$.

bound.expression: T*Delta_thr + sum_subopt(Delta_i*log(Max(T*KLe(mu_i + c_alg*Delta_i, mu_star - c_alg*Delta_i), E))/KLe(mu_i + c_alg*Delta_i, mu_star - c_alg*Delta_i) + Delta_i + Delta_i*(1/KLe(mu_i + c_alg*Delta_i, mu_star - c_alg*Delta_i) + 1/KLe(mu_i + c_alg*Delta_i, mu_i))) + Min(sum_subopt(Delta_i*(1/KLe(mu_star - c_alg*Delta_i, mu_star) + 1/KLe(mu_star - c_alg*Delta_i, mu_star)**2)), sum_subopt(Delta_i*(6 + 5*E*log(Max(T*KLe(mu_star - c_alg*Delta_i, mu_star), E)))/KLe(mu_star - c_alg*Delta_i, mu_star)))
bound.regime: for any Delta_thr > 0 and c in (0, 1/4]

symbols.Delta_thr: free analysis threshold Delta > 0; sums only over arms with Delta_i > Delta_thr
symbols.KLe: KL divergence between the members of the OPED family with the given means

conditions: Assumption 1: b twice differentiable with continuous b''>0
Assumption 3: all arms in a common known OPED family

source.label: corol:exp-kl-ms-mo
source.quote: For any $K$-arm bandit problem with \Cref{assum:oped,assum:max-variance,assum:reward-dist}, \expklms has: \[ \Regret(T) \leq \iupbound{ \sqrt{ \bar{V} KT\ln(K)} + \sum_{a\in[K]} \Delta_a}. \]

source.label: corol:exp-kl-ms-ao
source.quote: For any $K$-arm bandit problem with \Cref{assum:oped,assum:max-variance,assum:reward-dist}, \expklms satisfies that: \[ \limsup_{T \rightarrow \infty} \fr{ \Regret(T) }{\ln(T)} = \sum_{a\in[K]:\Delta_a>0} \frac{\Delta_a}{\KL{\mu_a}{\mu_{\max}}}. \]

results.notes: Asymptotic optimality; stated as equality, proof gives upper bound matched by Lai-Robbins.

symbols.V_bar: upper bound on the variance of any distribution in the OPED family

source.label: corol:exp-kl-ms-sub-ucb
source.quote: For any $K$-arm bandit problem with \Cref{assum:oped,assum:max-variance,assum:reward-dist}, \expklms satisfies that \[ \Regret(T) \leq \iupbound{\sum_{a: \Delta_a > 0} \frac{\bar{V}\ln(T)}{\Delta_a} + \Delta_a}. \]

symbols.V_max: variance of the optimal arm's reward distribution, V(mu_max)

source.label: corol:exp-kl-ms-adaptive-variance
source.quote: For any $K$-arm bandit problem with \Cref{assum:oped,assum:reward-dist,assum:lip}, \expklms has: \[ \Regret(T) \leq \iupbound{\sqrt{V(\mu_{\max}) KT\ln(K)} + K \ln(T)}. \]

results.notes: Variance-adaptive bound; O hides C_L dependence. Partially instance-dependent (through V(mu_max)).

bound.expression: T*Delta_thr + sum_subopt(Delta_i*log(Max(T*KLe(mu_i + c_alg*Delta_i, mu_star - c_alg*Delta_i), E))/KLe(mu_i + c_alg*Delta_i, mu_star - c_alg*Delta_i) + (2/(1 - 2*c_alg)**2 + 2/c_alg**2)*V_bar/Delta_i + Min(2*V_bar/(c_alg**2*Delta_i) + 4*V_bar**2/(c_alg**4*Delta_i**3), 2*(6 + 5*E)*V_bar/(c_alg**2*Delta_i)*log(Max(T*Delta_i**2/V_bar, E))))
bound.regime: for any Delta_thr > 0 and c in (0, 1/4]
